basics.name: Juan Monsalve
basics.label: Senior Frontend Developer
basics.summary: Senior Frontend Developer with 10+ years of experience building modern web applications with JavaScript, React, and cloud-based product teams. Strong background in frontend architecture, application modernization, state management, E2E automation, and WebGL/Three.js product visualization. Experienced collaborating remotely across distributed frontend and backend teams to deliver maintainable, high-quality user experiences.

work.name: Milestone Systems / Arcules
work.summary: Frontend engineer for a cloud-based Video Software as a Service (VSaaS) platform used to manage video cameras and related workflows. Built and maintained features for cases management, camera settings, and device status pages while contributing to E2E test automation, project modernization, and long-term frontend maintainability. Collaborated remotely with a 6-person frontend team and multiple backend teams distributed across different regions.

work.name: YR
work.summary: Led a team of 4 frontend developers building 3D product configurator experiences for a high-profile brand. Delivered in-store and ecommerce customization flows that allowed customers to personalize products and preview them in 3D, combining React, WebGL, Three.js, GraphQL integration, and automated testing practices.

work.name: Endava
